display.label: Azure Storage Queue
display.description: Azure Storage Queue for reliable asynchronous message queuing between distributed applications

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Storage Queue within the storage account. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Queue name and storage account association.

fields.label: Storage Account
fields.description: The Azure Storage Account where the queue should reside.

sections.label: Queue Settings & Metadata
sections.description: Optional metadata key-value pairs for the Storage Queue.

fields.label: Metadata
fields.description: A mapping of metadata key-value pairs assigned to this Storage Queue.
